name: change_world
description: Call this when the story has settled a change to the world. Fill the fields of the verb you pick. One call makes one change.

JoinParty.description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.
Exact id of an npc here.

LeaveParty.description: A party member stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

MoveItem.description: An item moves to a new holder.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item here or carried.

to.description: Exact id of the player, an npc here, or this place.

Rest.description: The player and the party spend a night here and heal to full Health.

Reveal.description: Something hidden here becomes known to the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here: an npc or an item.

UnlockWay.description: A locked way out of this place opens.

to_id.description: Exact id of the locked way's destination.

change.description: The change to apply. `verb` picks which one.

name: move
description: Call this to carry the player through an unlocked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place to move to.

with_ids.description: Exact ids of living npcs here who follow once. Party members come anyway.

name: roll
description: Call this for an uncertain action that carries a real cost. The engine rolls 2d6, adds the ability and the items, and reads the total.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

ability.description: Which ability the action calls on.

items.description: Exact ids of items the actor carries that plainly help.

difficulty.description: Difficulty Score: 8 easy, 10 moderate, 12 hard. Null when `against` is set.

against.description: Exact id of an npc here. Its Health is the Difficulty Score.

dangerous.description: True when a miss would hurt: a fight, a trap, a fall.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: level_up
description: Call this once, when the whole adventure ends. The engine opens the pick to the player, then to each living hired member in turn.

ability.description: Which ability to raise by 1. Null asks the player.

boost.description: Health or Inventory to raise by 1. Null asks the player.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: hire
description: Call this when the player hires someone here to work. Someone already travelling with the player can be hired too. The worldsmith writes their sheet once the turn ends. Nothing more lands this turn.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on.

terms.description: What they are hired for, and on what terms, as agreed.
